headline: You deleted your profile, but my routine still references your ID. I am just an ORPHAN ROW, pointing at nothing.
caption:
You deleted your profile, but my routine still references your ID. I am just an ORPHAN ROW, pointing at nothing.

—
ORPHAN ROW: a row whose foreign key points at something that no longer exists.
